# rhcs_oidcconfig_seaplane (Resource)

Manages OidcConfig resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Client-selected OIDC configuration name. Immutable after creation.
- `type` (String) Type.

### Optional

- `installer_role_arn` (String) InstallerRoleArn.
- `secret_arn` (String) SecretArn.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id.
- `issuer_url` (String) OIDC issuer URL. Computed by the controller for managed type.
- `phase` (String) Current lifecycle phase of the OIDC config (Pending, Ready, Error). Read-only.
- `thumbprint` (String) SHA-1 fingerprint of the OIDC issuer's TLS certificate. Computed by the controller and refreshed periodically. Read-only.
